patterns.prevention:
• **Screen** all coaches for engagement and energy levels during initial assessment and reference checks—prioritize candidates who demonstrate enthusiasm and rapport with children.

• **Brief** coaches before their first session on expectations around consistency, punctuality, and maintaining high energy; make clear that cancellations or no-shows will result in immediate replacement.

• **Monitor** attendance and engagement at each centre through weekly check-ins with managers and quarterly feedback surveys from centre staff—address performance issues within 2 weeks or swap the coach.

• **Retain** your strongest performers through recognition, scheduling stability, and a clear career path; identify backup coaches now for each centre so replacements can start within 7 days of notice.
